// RED fixture for `tenant-predicate` — the lint MUST reject this.
// A query-builder call that reads a tenant store with NO TenantId bound: the cross-tenant
// IDOR bug class (F2). There is no `.with_tenant(...)`, no `TenantId` arg, no RLS guard.
pub async fn list_principals(pool: &Pool) -> Vec<Principal> {
    sqlx::query("SELECT id, email FROM principals")
        .fetch_all(pool)
        .await
        .unwrap()
}
